name: Princess x Princess
source:
Fall has come to Verbena Academy.

Lithia couldn't be happier - this summer, her childhood crush Raito finally became her boyfriend. As a princess from the realm of the gods, she's getting her first taste of earthly autumn, letting herself get swept up in the seasonal blues.

As their love blossoms into marriage, Lithia ponders their future. Should they have a traditional monogamous wedding, like humans do? Or should she embrace her roots, where polygamy is the norm?

"You know what would make my relationship with Raito-kun perfect? A second bride!"

Without breathing a word to Raito, she starts her secret mission to find them another wife!

Meanwhile, out of nowhere, a mysterious plane touches down on the school grounds!

"Could Raito-kun's father be alive...?"

The sudden appearance of this enigmatic aircraft and its passenger - a girl who's lost her memories - marks the beginning of an extraordinary adventure at Verbena Academy, as autumn leaves begin to fall...!!

[Translated and edited from [url=https://project-navel.com/pripri/story.html] the official site[/url]]
translation:
马鞭草学园迎来了秋天。

莉西亚幸福极了。今年夏天，她终于与自幼憧憬的赖斗成为恋人。身为神界的公主，她第一次体验人间的秋季，任由季节的忧郁将自己包围。

当恋爱逐渐走向婚姻，莉西亚开始思考两人的未来。是像人类那样，举行一对一的婚礼，还是遵循故乡一夫多妻的传统？

“你知道，什么能让我和赖斗的关系变得完美吗？再添一位新娘！”

她没有告诉赖斗，就悄悄开始为两人物色另一位妻子！

与此同时，一架神秘的飞机突然降落在学园里！

“难道，赖斗的父亲还活着……？”

这架来历不明的飞机，以及机上那位失去记忆的女孩的突然出现，为秋叶飘落的马鞭草学园，揭开了一场非凡冒险的序幕！

[译编自[url=https://project-navel.com/pripri/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
